capabilities.description: Removes a block blob by name. Without `container` the config's defaultContainer is used. Set `ifMissing` to `ignore` to treat a missing blob as success with `deleted: false`; the default `error` fails the step with ECP_PROVIDER_ERROR (HTTP 404 from Azure).
capabilities.name: delete
projections: Check `deleted` to see whether Azure removed the blob (`false` only when `ifMissing` is `ignore` and the blob was absent)
Reuse `blobName` and `container` to confirm which object was addressed
capabilities.summary: Delete one blob from Azure Blob Storage.
useCases: Remove temporary uploads after an external service has read them
Clean up staging blobs once downstream steps no longer need them

capabilities.description: Fetches one blob into memory and writes it as a run artifact named after the last segment of the blob name, with the blob's Content-Type. Missing blobs fail the step with ECP_PROVIDER_ERROR and status 404.
capabilities.name: download
projections: Take `file` (an artifact ref) and pass it to the next step's file input
capabilities.summary: Download a blob into a run artifact.
useCases: Bring a stored blob into the run so later steps can read it as a file ref

capabilities.description: Creates a service SAS URL for an existing or future blob. Defaults to read-only for one hour; `permissions` takes the letters r, a, c, w and d. Needs an account key in the config (a connection string with AccountKey, or accountName and accountKey). The blob is not checked for existence.
capabilities.name: sas
projections: Take `sasUrl` as the link; `expiresOn` says when it stops working
capabilities.summary: Mint a signed URL for one blob.
useCases: Share a stored blob with a person or service for a limited time
Give an external service a write URL (`cw`) to upload a result directly

capabilities.description: Reads a file ref (local path, URL or run artifact) and stores it as a block blob, overwriting any blob with the same name. Without `blobName` it picks a unique name, `ecp/<runId>/<stepId>/<name>-<8 hex>` plus the file extension; without `container` the config's defaultContainer is used. By default the returned `file` url is a one-hour read SAS (`createReadSas`, default true); set it to false for the bare blob URL on public containers. Use `sas` for other permissions or lifetimes.
capabilities.name: upload
projections: Bind `file` (a url FileRef) into url-only capability inputs; keep `blobName` and `container` for delete or sas
capabilities.summary: Upload a file to Azure Blob Storage.
useCases: Persist generated media or reports so later steps or people can fetch them
Hand a file to an external service that only accepts URLs (bind `file` into url-only inputs)

plugin.description: Blob storage for executions that persist media, share time-limited links, bring stored objects into a run as artifacts, or remove blobs after use. The config object holds either a connection string or an account name and key (as secret references), plus an optional default container. Node hosts only.
plugin.summary: Upload, download, delete and mint SAS URLs for Azure Blob Storage.
